descriptions.normal: A vegetable salad. The freshest fruits and vegetables are selected and arrayed alongside rye bread and sprinkled with dressing, making for a delicious and satisfying dish that finds its way daily onto the tables of pious Frostmoon Scions.
descriptions.suspicious: A vegetable salad. For some reason, there is an earthy, almost dirt-like flavor, as though you're eating untreated grass. Perhaps a Rimehorn Deer might enjoy this dish better...
descriptions.delicious: A vegetable salad. A vibrant array of vegetables is given sweetness by the presence of juicy berries and delicately garnished with petals, creating a bountiful feast that blossoms across the taste buds.

effectTexts.normal: Restores 28% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 620 HP every 5s for 30s.
effectTexts.suspicious: Restores 26% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 450 HP every 5s for 30s.
effectTexts.delicious: Restores 30% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 790 HP every 5s for 30s.
